card.name: Mid-URL and title continuation words
card.fires_on: Words inside web addresses and phone numbers, and the word right after a heading start such as Social and Emotional or Sexual. Also colons after label phrases.

modes.label: URL and phone pieces
modes.description: Parts of web addresses or toll-free numbers where the next piece is expected to continue.

modes.label: Title words and colons
modes.description: A word or colon inside a title or heading that continues into another term.
modes.example: Social and Emotional<< Development>>, Physical Development, Creative Development -

modes.label: Noun after "no available"
modes.description: A modifier in a data statement that is followed by a noun.
modes.example: There are no available<< human>> data to assess for any drug associated risks

card.plain: It fires partway through web links, phone numbers and titles, where the text is sure to keep going.
